## 2. Stats of each variant relative to the Normal form of the same monster

Average over every object × 5 rarities at level 6 (same seed). Old = what build 19 did, new = now.

| Variant | HP old → new | ATK old → new | DEF old → new | SPD old → new |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spectral | -12.3% → -8.1% | +6.8% → +5.2% | -5.2% → +0.0% | +18.4% → +15.8% |
| Mutated | +7.1% → +8.1% | +21.8% → +11.8% | -9.2% → -3.1% | -3.1% → +0.0% |
| Prismatic | +8.1% → +8.1% | +8.2% → +8.1% | +10.8% → +10.6% | +7.7% → +7.9% |

Old Spectral/Mutated numbers are averages because they REPLACED the family table (a Food monster lost its Food stats); new numbers are fixed modifiers on top of the family.
